changeSet.comment: Create demo lead notes and activities showing lead progression and sales interactions

column.name: content
column.value: Initial discovery call completed. David is evaluating CRM solutions for their 500+ engineering team. Key pain points: current system lacks API integrations, no SSO support, and limited analytics. Budget range: $75K-$100K annually. Decision committee includes David (technical), CFO (budget), and CEO (final approval). Timeline: Decision by end of February 2025. Next steps: Technical demo scheduled for next week.

column.name: content
column.value: Technical requirements gathering session. Must-haves: REST API with rate limiting, SAML SSO integration, advanced reporting with custom dashboards, data export capabilities, and SOC2 compliance. Nice-to-haves: Mobile app, webhook integrations, and custom field support. David impressed with our API documentation and security posture. Requested POC environment for 2-week evaluation.

column.name: content
column.value: CONVERSION SUCCESS: Michael Rodriguez successfully converted to Enterprise customer! Lead-to-customer journey: Website inquiry (Sept 2024) → Discovery calls (Oct 2024) → Technical evaluation (Oct-Nov 2024) → Contract signed (Nov 15, 2024). Key success factors: Strong technical fit, clear ROI demonstration ($2.3M efficiency gains), and excellent relationship building. Annual contract value: $180K. This conversion validates our enterprise sales process and technical capabilities.

column.name: content
column.value: Partner referral from StartupHub Accelerator. Lisa is COO at Series A startup (25 employees, $5M funding round in progress). Looking for scalable CRM to support growth from 25 to 100+ employees over next 18 months. Budget constraints due to startup stage, but has 20% partner discount. Interested in our Starter plan with upgrade path to Pro. Decision timeline tied to funding completion (expected Q1 2025).
